# SCI-NOI v0.1 — Scientific-Owner ODQ-102A Approval

Decision identity: `SCI-NOI-ODQ-102A`

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Decision date: `2026-08-29`

Status: approved scientific route identity; numerical realization remains
conditional on the frozen PTC-to-MAP gates

## Exact Owner Decision

> The ordinary fixed-state NOI-GEN route shall apply the NOI-defined
> realization assignment at the PTC→MAP numerical boundary. The realization
> modifier may be consumed and applied inline by MAP during accumulation; no
> materialized randomized timestream is required. NOI owns the assignment,
> ensemble design, and realization identity; MAP owns only the conforming
> application of that modifier within its ordinary accumulation arithmetic.
> The resulting map is an NOI realization product produced through the frozen
> MAP operator, not an ordinary MAP science product.

## Sanitized Disposition

The ordinary route is exactly
`NOI-GEN/PTC-TO-FROZEN-MAP-CONDITIONAL-SIGN@1`.

The earliest immutable parent is the exact PTC occurrence population admitted
at `SCI-PTC_TO_SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.1`. NOI's route-specific assignment modifier is
applied at that numerical boundary before each occurrence contributes to the
frozen MAP accumulation operator. Materializing an intermediate randomized
timestream is optional representation, never scientific identity or a
publication prerequisite.

NOI owns the assignment, finite ensemble design, member identity, ensemble
identity, and NOI realization product. MAP owns conformance of the inline or
materialized modifier application to the same frozen accumulation arithmetic,
projection, coefficient, normalization, support, boundary, WCS, response, and
lifecycle state. MAP does not thereby own the realization design or reclassify
the result as an ordinary MAP science product.

The output is an `NOI-GEN` realization map produced through the frozen MAP
operator. It inherits the route-declared MAP-domain quantity, unit, beam,
WCS/frame, support, and response meanings, but not ordinary MAP science-product
identity or claims.

## Availability And Non-Implications

This decision selects route identity but does not create a numerical parent.
The route remains numerically unavailable until the frozen PTC/MAP boundary
supplies the selected numerical PTC MAP-facing coefficient family/value/QC and
the exact owner-admitted numerical `coverage_cut` state/value and failure
policy.

The decision selects no coherence-unit family, sign law, finite design,
source-cancellation claim, UNC estimator, covariance, weight, STD product,
filter, persistence mode, or VAL profile. Those remain separate decisions.
